dependency_rules.scoring_through_service: All match scoring must go through scoring_service.py; never compute scores inline in routes or repositories.
dependency_rules.compliance_through_service: All EUDR and REACH compliance scoring must go through compliance_service.py; never bypass or duplicate compliance logic.
dependency_rules.lane_through_service: All lane economics data must go through lane_service.py; never hardcode freight benchmarks in routes or components.
dependency_rules.outreach_through_service: All outreach message generation must go through outreach_service.py; never generate messages directly in API routes.
dependency_rules.repository_layer: All database access goes through the repository layer; no raw SQL in service files, no business logic in repository files.
dependency_rules.medallion_flow_only: Bronze to Silver to Gold is the only valid data flow direction; never write from Gold back to Silver or Bronze.
dependency_rules.match_requires_explainability: Every match candidate must have score, score_version, and at least one driver object; never insert a match without explainability.
dependency_rules.history_insert_only: gold.match_score_history and audit.audit_event are INSERT ONLY; never UPDATE or DELETE those rows.
dependency_rules.signal_requires_evidence: Every signal must have evidence JSONB; never create a signal with empty evidence.
dependency_rules.contact_requires_confidence: Every contact must have a confidence_score; never insert a contact without a confidence value.
dependency_rules.lane_benchmark_requires_date: Every lane benchmark must have an effective_start date; never insert a benchmark without dating it.
dependency_rules.api_routes_require_pydantic: API routes must use Pydantic schemas for all request and response bodies; never return raw SQLAlchemy model objects.
dependency_rules.api_key_required: Every API route except /health must require the X-TradeOS-Key header via the require_api_key dependency.
dependency_rules.phase3_isolation: Phase 3 features (pgvector, LangGraph agents) must not pollute Phase 1/2 service or repository code; keep them in dedicated modules.
